evidence.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
rec_path = root/'experiments/stage10/06_recovery/RECOVERY_ENDPOINTS.csv'
ledger_path = root/'experiments/stage10/06_recovery/TARGET_WRITE_LEDGER.jsonl'
large_path = root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/LARGE_EVAL_SUMMARY.json'
token_path = root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv'
split_path = root/'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/D_EVAL_STAGE10_V1_SPLIT_SUMMARY.json'
summary_path = root/'experiments/stage10/06_recovery/RECOVERY_TRAIN_EVAL_SUMMARY.json'
state_path = root/'experiments/stage10/00_freeze/STAGE10_STATE.json'
with rec_path.open(newline='') as f:
    rec_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
with ledger_path.open() as f:
    ledger_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]
key_fields = ('run_group','model_id','candidate_id','floorplan_id','adapter_rank','seed','budget_tokens','run_manifest_sha256')
rec_keys = Counter(tuple(str(row.get(k,'')) for k in key_fields) for row in rec_rows)
ledger_keys = Counter(tuple(str(row.get(k,'')) for k in key_fields) for row in ledger_rows)
with token_path.open(newline='') as f:
    token_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
large = json.loads(large_path.read_text())
split = json.loads(split_path.read_text())
recovery_summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text())
state = json.loads(state_path.read_text())
result = {
    'recovery_endpoint_rows': len(rec_rows),
    'target_write_ledger_rows': len(ledger_rows),
    'endpoint_ledger_key_symmetric_difference': sum((rec_keys-ledger_keys).values()) + sum((ledger_keys-rec_keys).values()),
    'summary_target_write_ledger_matches_endpoint_rows': recovery_summary.get('target_write_ledger_matches_endpoint_rows'),
    'state_target_write_ledger_rows': state.get('target_write_ledger_rows'),
    'large_eval_evaluated_endpoint_rows': large.get('evaluated_endpoint_rows'),
    'large_eval_expected_formal_endpoint_rows': large.get('expected_formal_endpoint_rows'),
    'token_weighted_total_rows': len(token_rows),
    'token_weighted_original_rows': sum(1 for r in token_rows if r.get('source_endpoint_type') == 'original_reference'),
    'token_weighted_trained_rows': sum(1 for r in token_rows if r.get('endpoint_kind') == 'trained_checkpoint'),
    'large_eval_summary_total_rows_including_original': large.get('total_table_rows_including_original'),
    'large_eval_models': sorted(large.get('model_counts', {}).keys()),
    'large_eval_model_row_counts': {model: info.get('row_count') for model, info in sorted(large.get('model_counts', {}).items())},
    'split_version': split.get('split_version'),
    'split_count': split.get('split_count'),
    'split_summary_rows': len(split.get('split_summaries', [])),
    'split_record_count': split.get('record_count'),
    'split_status': split.get('status'),
    'split_hard_failure_count': len(split.get('hard_failures', [])),
    'split_boundary_recovery_overlap_count': split.get('split_boundary_audit', {}).get('recovery_overlap_count'),
    'split_boundary_status': split.get('split_boundary_audit', {}).get('status'),
}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
PY
evidence.title: Read-only recomputation of Stage10 recovery, ledger, large-eval, and split counts
